turns.said: Hello. How do I register for a TIN number with URA?
assistant: To register for a TIN with URA, visit the official URA web portal at https://ura.go.ug, navigate to **eServices** > **Tm Registration**, and submit your completed online application. Are you registering as an **individual** or an **organisation**?

turns.said: What is the standard VAT rate in Uganda?
assistant: The standard Value Added Tax (VAT) rate in Uganda is **18%**. This is charged on taxable supplies of goods and services.
